correctness.rationale: The precise canonical permutations have eight explicit precedence covers, the rooted-tree hook count is 280, and a strictly exposed-vertex argument excludes redundancies. Two independent exhaustive generators agree on the set; exact integer pairwise enumeration covers C(280,2)=39060 cases and independently checks all 75 multiplicities and diameter degrees. The complete proof is finite; there is no extrapolation.

value.rationale: The three-bar first midpoint refinement is a canonical next complexity after endpoint-only barcodes, explicitly motivated by enhanced overlap discrimination in the founding paper. The complete realization-specific Euclidean metric supplies all edge appearance scales for Rips constructions and settles the exact diameter graph, sharp second shell and missing near-diameter shell, rather than an arbitrary single unrelated integer. It does not claim persistent homology or a general theorem.
